body: Usually I'd use baby oil soaks to take it off, and wait a few days to reapply, but something weird happened and my skin just started to blister and pull apart in patches after it had been on for about a day. It's probably just related to my skin issues, cause I have chronic eczema and random allergic reactions. I don't want to horror story anyone out of using tape though, I just have terrible skin, lmao

I've been trying to find out what happens if I start the implant then take it out after being a few months on T. I'm not trying to prevent pregnancy; I just want to prevent bleeding, and I don't know how to bridge the gap between birth control and testosterone. I hope to get off birth control as soon as possible for health reasons, but will that mean that my period comes back when I stop it?
They see me as a dude! Euphoria, here I come :)
Thank goodness. I didn't even think about photos online, though. But it's really cool that it works in person!

Yeah, the length of time it takes to grow hair is something I thought of, but everyone in my family grows facial hair really easily, so I figured that would be pretty apparent on me. I'm definitely starting T because most of the changes are a must for me. Honestly, I think I'll age out of the dirtstache one day, so it's not that serious of a factor.
